# SD18 deterministic Human Wizard level 13 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Wizard
# level-1..level-12 prepared arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_wizard_level12_widening.rs) to Wizard level 13 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from
# the level-1..level-12 fixtures, and the same canonical school
# specialization selections (Evocation chosen, Necromancy/Transmutation
# opposed), adding only the level bump this cycle needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Wizard burden surface: no evocation
# spell-damage application, no force-missile casting execution, no
# opposed-school preparation cost, no spellbook, no spells prepared, no spell
# slots, no spell DCs, no bonus-feat selection/execution for the
# still-unproven 5th/10th-level "Bonus feat" grants, and no level-14+
# progression. Both PF1 CRB primary sources (d20pfsrd and the Archives of
# Nethys aonprd.com mirror) were read directly before writing this fixture,
# and they agree byte-for-byte: the level-13 base attack bonus and all three
# base saves STAY numerically unchanged from level 12 (`13/2 = 6`, `13/3 = 4`,
# `13/3 = 4`, `13/2+2 = 8`, integer-division coincidences, not a sign any
# formula stopped scaling). The raw Wizard spells-per-day table's level-13 row
# is "4/4/4/4/4/3/2/1", the first non-"—" 7th-level column, up from the
# level-12 row "4/4/4/4/3/3/2" whose 7th-level column does not exist at all —
# so a level-13 specialist wizard casts 7th-level spells for the first time,
# and the specialist bonus-slot flat count (one bonus slot of each spell
# level she can cast) GENUINELY RISES to 7, from 6 at level 12. Intense
# Spells' bonus-damage magnitude STAYS at 6 (`max(13/2, 1) = 6`, another
# integer-division coincidence); Force Missile's uses-per-day pool stays
# level-independent and unchanged; Scribe Scroll stays recognized as an
# already-held grant. The level-13 "Special" column is genuinely BLANK on
# both primary sources (the Wizard's bonus feats land only at levels
# 5/10/15/20), so no new pillar is added at level 13 — only the
# already-grounded arithmetic pillars widen.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-wizard-level13-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:wizard:13
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:17
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:wizard_school_specialization:school:evocation
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:necromancy
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:transmutation
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:intelligence
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
